How to verify: Match species, grade, core, thickness, finish, color, and manufacturer requirements to the released project.
Pass criteria: The purchase description is specific enough to prevent an unapproved substitution.

How to verify: Distinguish nominal dimensions from measured usable dimensions after damage, trim, defects, and squaring.
Pass criteria: The material plan fits the smallest accepted usable stock.

How to verify: Reconcile optimized need, yield assumption, defect allowance, setup pieces, and spare policy.
Pass criteria: Ordered quantity has an explicit and reproducible basis.

How to verify: Record supplier, lot, date, measured condition, defects, and disposition before stock is mixed.
Pass criteria: Accepted, returned, quarantined, and conditional material are visibly separated.

How to verify: Mark which individual edges receive banding and whether they are applied before or after machining.
Pass criteria: Footage traces to named parts and edges.

How to verify: Confirm band thickness at doors, drawers, shelves, fillers, and hardware interfaces.
Pass criteria: Finished dimensions and reveals include the applied edge.

How to verify: Add setup strips, end trimming, roll remnants, repairs, and approved spare footage.
Pass criteria: The order supports the actual machine or hand-application process.
